source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to ligand exchange reactions (PDF 27).

blocks.text: Agar ban sakne wala naya complex maujooda complex se zyada mustahkam ho to ligands badal jate (exchange hote) hain. Naye complex ki khasiyatein, jaise rang, banawat aur reactivity, mukhtalif hoti hain. Copper(II) aur cobalt(II) ions ke complexes ligand exchange ko wazeh dikhate hain.

blocks.title: Ligand exchange
blocks.text: Ligand exchange (substitution) reaction woh hai jis mein complex ke aik ya zyada ligands doosre ligands se badal jate hain.

blocks.explanation: Jab naye ligands se banne wala complex asal complex se zyada mustahkam ho.

items: Naya complex zyada mustahkam ho to ligands badalte; rang aur shakal badal sakti hai.
